author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
Hello guys, this is my second report about The user Heimskr.
He just got ban again for ban evasion but appealed again, but why Im reporting this?

Im not saying Heims doesn't have a brother but I'm sure he ban evaded on the Avicus Network by hes own because he was ban evading for joining Eternal Cross.
How I am sure? Because I talked to him on Teamspeak3 that he couldn't join ETCR 'cos he was banned, but he replied me that he had an alt account and that account was going to use it for playing with us.
As I said, I'm not saying that accounts its not from hes real brother but he used it for hes own porpuse on the Avicus Network.

Kindest regards
Nova.
